106/**
107 * Determines the number of error correction codewords for a specified error correction
108 * level.
109 *
110 * @param errorCorrectionLevel the error correction level (0-8)
111 * @return the number of codewords generated for error correction
112 */
113pub fn getErrorCorrectionCodewordCount(errorCorrectionLevel: u32) -> Result<u32> {
114    if errorCorrectionLevel > 8 {
115        return Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with(
116            "Error correction level must be between 0 and 8!",
117        ));
118    }
119    Ok(1 << (errorCorrectionLevel + 1))
120}
121
122/**
123 * Returns the recommended minimum error correction level as described in annex E of
124 * ISO/IEC 15438:2001(E).
125 *
126 * @param n the number of data codewords
127 * @return the recommended minimum error correction level
128 */
129pub fn getRecommendedMinimumErrorCorrectionLevel(n: u32) -> Result<u32> {
130    if n == 0 {
131        Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with("n must be > 0"))
132    } else if n <= 40 {
133        Ok(2)
134    } else if n <= 160 {
135        Ok(3)
136    } else if n <= 320 {
137        Ok(4)
138    } else if n <= 863 {
139        Ok(5)
140    } else {
141        Err(Exceptions::writer_with("No recommendation possible"))
142    }
143}

145/**
146 * Generates the error correction codewords according to 4.10 in ISO/IEC 15438:2001(E).
147 *
148 * @param dataCodewords        the data codewords
149 * @param errorCorrectionLevel the error correction level (0-8)
150 * @return the String representing the error correction codewords
151 */
152pub fn generateErrorCorrection(dataCodewords: &str, errorCorrectionLevel: u32) -> Result<String> {
153    let k = getErrorCorrectionCodewordCount(errorCorrectionLevel)?;
154    let mut e = vec![0 as char; k as usize]; //new char[k];
155    let sld = dataCodewords.chars().count();
156    let cached_data_codewords = dataCodewords.chars().collect::<Vec<_>>();
157    for i in 0..sld {
158        let t1 = (cached_data_codewords
159            .get(i)
160            .copied()
161            .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)? as u32
162            + e[e.len() - 1] as u32)
163            % 929;
164        let mut t2;
165        let mut t3;
166        let mut j = k as usize - 1;
167        while j >= 1 {
168            t2 = (t1 * EC_COEFFICIENTS[errorCorrectionLevel as usize][j]) % 929;
169            t3 = 929 - t2;
170            e[j] = char::from_u32((e[j - 1] as u32 + t3) % 929).ok_or(Exceptions::PARSE)?;
171            j -= 1;
172        }
173        t2 = (t1 * EC_COEFFICIENTS[errorCorrectionLevel as usize][0]) % 929;
174        t3 = 929 - t2;
175        e[0] = char::from_u32(t3 % 929).ok_or(Exceptions::PARSE)?;
176    }
177    let mut sb = String::with_capacity(k as usize);
178    let mut j = k as isize - 1;
179    while j >= 0 {
180        if e[j as usize] as u32 != 0 {
181            e[j as usize] = char::from_u32(929 - e[j as usize] as u32).ok_or(Exceptions::PARSE)?;
182        }
183        sb.push(e[j as usize]);
184
185        j -= 1;
186    }
187    Ok(sb)
188}
